properties.evidence: upstream.rs accepted a document as a design record as soon as it parsed into GraphExport (observe_one, baseline_hash). GraphExport deliberately defaults every field (graph_id optional since BL-138, nodes and edges default) so a hand-authored document can be imported, so every JSON object parses. Measured: a stand-in server whose export_graph reply was {"hello":"world"} produced Fingerprint { graph_id: "", nodes: 0, content_hash: sha256:0f34… } instead of an error.
